programs.title: Back Roads
programs.desc: Back Roads continues along Central Australia's remote Binns Track, connecting people and cultures. Rae Johnston arrives just in time for one of the most action-packed events in the Northern Territory, the Harts Range Races.

programs.title: Antiques Roadshow
programs.desc: The Roadshow returns to Pitzhanger Manor and Gallery in West London, where finds include a unique engagement ring, a note written by Oscar Wilde and an Olympic medal from the 1930s.

programs.title: Compass
programs.sub_title: Labassa - If These Walls Could Talk
programs.desc: Compass was given rare access to Labassa, the historic Renaissance mansion in Melbourne to film many of the remaining tenants. We focus on the post war years of Jewish refugees and 1970's bohemians, artists and performers.

programs.title: ABC News
programs.desc: News from where we live. ABC News NSW brings you the day's top stories, exclusive investigations and original reporting on the issues that matter to you. Presented by Jeremy Fernandez.

programs.title: The Assembly
programs.desc: Autistic journalism students interview one of the most famous performers in Australia - Jimmy Barnes. He's at his most candid and vulnerable in this interview, revealing the highs and lows of working as a famous musician.

programs.title: Bad Company
programs.desc: Julia learns about Margie's famous sister, Caitlen Allard, and wonders whether she's found her cash cow. Margie's mentor, a French clown, moves into The Argyle, creating a headache for Julia's sponsorship plans.
